boardProfile.layout: Block Out Level 110 hides a single connected red polyomino in the center of a tall purple frame — it looks like three separate blocks, but moves as one piece. A top `11` gate and left-rail `8` column seal the orange-bordered blue `3` pocket below, and a dense `19` cluster fills the bottom. Split the red shape too early and the pink L-piece on the right gets permanently trapped.
landmarks: Block Out Level 110 hides a single connected red polyomino in the center of a tall purple frame — it looks like three separate blocks, but moves as one piece.
A top `11` gate and left-rail `8` column seal the orange-bordered blue `3` pocket below, and a dense `19` cluster fills the bottom.
Split the red shape too early and the pink L-piece on the right gets permanently trapped.

quickTips: Break the center red polyomino as one shape — do not split it early.
Clear the left-rail `8` before sliding any bottom-cluster pieces.
Think in chain clears. The best move is the one that sets up the next two moves, not just the quickest current match.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Remove the top light-blue `11` tile to unlock the orange-bordered center pocket.

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Peel the left-rail `8` column before sliding any bottom-cluster pieces.

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Clear the space around the center blue `3` pocket without splitting the bottom `19` cluster.

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Shift the center red polyomino as one shape, keeping the yellow highlight line intact.

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Free the right-side pink `1` tile and the lower pink L-piece after the red shape moves.

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Finish the remaining blue base blocks and close the bottom counters `3` and `14`.

failurePoints: Splitting the center red polyomino too early, which traps the right pink L-piece.
Touching the bottom `19` cluster before the top `11` tile and left-rail `8` are gone.
